note: The original records the alate as Unknown; it also notes that Akhtar (1975) had misidentified this species as G. nigrifrons.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The type locality is Khagribari Forest, Cooch Behar district, West Bengal, India (26°20′ N, 89°35′ E), and the species is known from that area only. The alate is unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown, dark brown in front and paler behind; antennae yellow; labrum pale brown; mandibles blackish brown, dark brown behind; pronotum slightly paler than the posterior part of the head; abdomen milky white, tergite 10 brown and strongly sclerotized. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 5.0—7.0 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, about 1.5 times as long as wide; length to the base of the mandibles 1.34—1.58 mm, width 1.04—1.13 mm; sides nearly straight or slightly converging anteriorly; anterolateral corners sharply projecting; posterior margin rounded; anterodorsal projection present; frons sloping forwards at about 45° and concave in the middle; Y-suture weak. Eyes oval, 0.10—0.13 mm long and 0.07—0.09 mm wide, white, separated from the antennal socket by a distance equal to their short diameter. Ocelli absent. Antennae 11—12-segmented; segment 1 long and cylindrical; segment 2 shorter than segment 1; segment 3 the smallest and slender, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3. Clypeus nearly trapezoidal; anteclypeus hairless, thin, transparent and band-like; postclypeus hairy, the boundary with the frons weak. Labrum nearly square, rounded in front, hairy on the anterior part and on the body of the labrum. Mandibles thick and short, about half the head length, 0.65—0.78 mm long; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first and second small and close together, the third larger, with a rounded concave edge between it and the second, situated in the middle; right mandible with 2 rather distinct marginal teeth in the basal half. Postmentum club-shaped, the waist in the posterior half, the waist width from less than half to about half of the greatest width; length 0.90—1.17 mm, greatest width 0.35—0.43 mm, waist width 0.16—0.20 mm. Pronotum flat, nearly rectangular, only slightly narrower than the head capsule; length 0.50—0.63 mm, width 0.90—1.13 mm; anterior margin slightly incurved with a shallow median notch; sides rounded; posterior margin bowed outwards. Mesonotum and metanotum shorter than the pronotum, posterior margins weakly concave. Legs short and hairy; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate, sparsely hairy; tergite 10 strongly sclerotized; cerci 2-segmented; styli one-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudergate: head and body milky white, sparsely hairy. Body length 5.0—6.0 mm. Head capsule nearly circular, length to the base of the mandibles 0.90—1.03 mm, width 0.92—1.00 mm. Eyes small, oval, vestigial. Antennae 10—11-segmented. Labrum broadly tongue-shaped. Mandibles of the typical Glyptotermes type, each with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth. Pronotum flat, nearly rectangular, length 0.53—0.61 mm, width 0.96—1.03 mm, as wide as the head or slightly wider; anterior margin distinctly incurved in the middle. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
